knownGaps.why: An API price list spans eight orders of magnitude — $0.08 per million tokens beside $10.00 per thousand calls. No single page-wide decimal count can make both readable, so the shared shape breaks here by construction rather than by mistake.

$0.08 per million tokens is 0.0000001 ZEC. The rule that a nonzero price must never render as 0.00 expands it to ten decimals, which nobody can read. The open question is whether a price this small should convert at all.
